verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants and autonomous agents manage company finances via natural-language requests (e.g., 'ask about card spend, pay a vendor, pull a statement, or submit a reimbursement') without opening the app, covering cards, reimbursements, vendors, and transactions. This directly supports natural-language operation for AI-native users, though it is all vendor-provided documentation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of MCP natural-language interactions, and broader coverage beyond the listed actions.
